# NameValuePair

A named text value, such as one input of a run.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests and responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The name. Constraints: minLength: 1, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `value` | `string` | The value, as text (it may be empty). Constraints: required. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "...",
  "value": "..."
}
```
